purpose: Regression scenarios derived from publicly reported 2026 race-strategy turning points. They test decision invariants, not exact team simulation data.

cases.public_observation: Mercedes stopped under the lap-11 VSC while Ferrari stayed out; the discounted stop and clear air became strategically decisive.
cases.expected_invariant: For the same legal tyre plan, VSC risk-adjusted time must be materially lower than green-flag time.
cases.source_note: Public race reports from Formula 1 coverage and season reporting. Exact hidden team models are unavailable.

cases.public_observation: A well-timed safety-car stop helped Antonelli convert a compromised early phase into the winning position.
cases.expected_invariant: A full-SC stop receives a larger discount than VSC and can move the preferred stop earlier when tyre and traffic conditions support it.
cases.source_note: Associated Press race report; test uses a synthetic telemetry state, not proprietary Mercedes data.

cases.public_observation: Hamilton pitted during the late safety car while Russell stayed out; the race ended neutralised and track position decided second place.
cases.expected_invariant: With only a few laps left under a full SC, a stop that loses positions must carry a large classification-risk penalty.
cases.source_note: Reuters/Guardian race reporting; classification risk is represented as a bounded ranking penalty.

cases.public_observation: A tyre change during suspension is not modelled as an ordinary green-flag drive-through loss.
cases.expected_invariant: Red-flag tyre changes have zero normal pit-loss cost while compound legality still applies for the remaining race.
cases.source_note: FIA sporting-rule treatment encoded as a strategy invariant.

cases.public_observation: A strategy model must not force a lazy one-stop when measured personal per-wheel wear makes the long final stint infeasible.
cases.expected_invariant: At sufficiently high measured wear, a two-stop plan outranks every feasible one-stop plan despite the extra pit loss.
cases.source_note: Synthetic stress case calibrated from Pit Wall personal telemetry fields.
